title: Authentication
description: All API requests require an API key passed in the Authorization header.

sections.title: Getting your API key
items: Log in to your QRise account
Navigate to API Manager in the sidebar
Copy the key immediately — it cannot be shown again

rows: Read QR codes, list, export, analytics

sections.title: Making authenticated requests
sections.content: Include your API key in the Authorization header:

sections.title: API key security
sections.content: Never commit API keys to source control. Use environment variables. Rotate keys immediately if exposed.

sections.title: Demo key
sections.content: The Try-It console includes a pre-filled demo key for testing. It's read-only and limited to 10 calls per hour.
